title: Result Day
season_arc: Six days to the exam and then the wait for the result: Meera has to reach the exam hall, and the family has to decide who she is to them.

characters.name: Meera
characters.personality: Patient, observant, proud, says little and remembers everything
characters.voice: Soft, steady young woman's voice, Hindi with a Lucknow politeness

episodes.title: Result Day, Ep 1: Chawal Ka Dabba
episodes.summary: A daughter-in-law treated as the household help is secretly studying for the civil services exam at 4 a.m., until her mother-in-law finds the books hidden in the rice.
episodes.cliffhanger: Sarla holds Meera's admit card over the gas flame as Meera walks in.
